description: This file defines an abstract PHPUnit test case class `TestCase` within the `OrangeHRM\Tests\Util` namespace. It extends PHPUnit's base test case and includes utility methods for reflection and mock object manipulation, facilitating unit testing of classes that may have private or protected methods. It also uses a trait `EntityManagerTrait` to provide database entity reference functionality.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for unit tests in OrangeHRM, providing utility methods for reflection and method invocation, primarily to test classes with private or protected methods.

methods.name: getEntityReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to an entity object by its class name and ID, utilizing the EntityManager trait.

methods.name: getClassMethod
methods.description: Uses reflection to retrieve a class method and set it accessible, enabling invocation of private or protected methods.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethod
methods.description: Invokes a private method of a class with specified parameters.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a private method on a mock object using reflection.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethod
methods.description: Invokes a protected method of a class with specified parameters, utilizing the private method invocation logic.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a protected method on a mock object.
